insights: A large share of drivers repeatedly alternate between airport-bound and airport-originating trips, and some often return to the airport on their next recorded trip.
Corridor activity peaks in midday and afternoon periods, while airport-originating departures are less common at midday and late night.
Taxi-stand trips follow more regular routes to the airport, while nearby street-hail trips use more diverse routes despite having similar origins.
summary: Drivers frequently alternate airport direction, with a smaller frequent-return subset. Midday and afternoon carry the most corridor activity, while comparable inbound stand and street-hail trips differ clearly in route regularity.
